blocks.text: Non-polar ya be-charge molecules pani mein hal nahin hote, kyun ke pani ke molecules un se hydrogen bonds nahin banate. Jab inhein pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules inhein bahar dhakel dete hain. Yeh na-hal hone wale molecules aapas mein hydrophobic jor (associations) bana lete hain. Maslan lipid molecules pani mein hal nahin hote; pani se bahar dhakele jane par yeh aapas mein mazbooti se jur jate hain. Isi liye lipids cells ki membranes qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain (Figure 4.9: pani mein tel ki boondein aapas mein jur jati hain).
